Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7941); Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine:--Sychar.
BiblicalUsage: Sychar is the city of Samaria where Jesus comes, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph. The well, the woman, and the talk of living water all begin at Sychar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sychar matters because Jacob's ground became the ground of a Samaritan's faith, and the well there still gives living water.
